   "source": [
    "# Beyond the Toy Model: f(R) Gravity \u2014 Paper Figures & Tables",
    "",
    "Run every cell top to bottom (Kernel -> Restart & Run All) to regenerate every",
    "figure and table in the paper from source code, with plots displayed inline",
    "below each cell."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Colab setup: clone the repo if running on Google Colab (src/ and data/",
    "# aren't available otherwise, since Colab only opens the single .ipynb file).",
    "import os, sys",
    "",
    "IN_COLAB = 'google.colab' in sys.modules",
    "if IN_COLAB:",
    "    REPO_URL = 'https://github.com/murafi99/fR-viability-trilemma-growth-test.git'",
    "    REPO_DIR = 'fR-viability-trilemma-growth-test'",
    "    if not os.path.exists(REPO_DIR):",
    "        !git clone -q {REPO_URL}",
    "    os.chdir(REPO_DIR)",
    "    !pip install -q -r requirements.txt"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import sys, os",
    "sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath('.'))",
    "import numpy as np",
    "import pandas as pd",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt",
    "%matplotlib inline",
    "",
    "from src.models import model_A, model_B, hu_sawicki_n1, check_viability",
    "from src.background import designer_R, forward_shoot",
    "from src.growth import fsigma8_of_z, solve_growth",
    "from src.screening import fR0_model_A, thin_shell_violation, chameleon_bvp_attempt",
    "from src.fit_data import load_data, run_table3, run_table4",
    "",
    "Om0, OL0 = 0.3, 0.7"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Table 1 \u2014 Standard f(R) viability conditions (N1-N4)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "execute_result",
     "execution_count": 2,
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "  condition  ...              physical_meaning",
       "0        N1  ...                      No ghost",
       "1        N2  ...    No Dolgov-Kawasaki tachyon",
       "2        N3  ...                   GR recovery",
       "3        N4  ...  Stable late-time fixed point",
       "",
       "[4 rows x 3 columns]"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {}
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "table1 = pd.read_csv('results/table1_viability_conditions.csv')",
    "table1"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Figure 1 \u2014 Model A: $f_A(R) = R - \\\\lambda R_c \\\\tanh(R/R_c)$",
    "Satisfies N1 (no ghost) and N2 (no tachyon) everywhere for $R>0$."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "Model A viability: {'N1_no_ghost': True, 'N2_no_tachyon': True}",
      ""
     ]
    },
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {}
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "R = np.linspace(1e-3, 8, 400)",
    "f, fp, fpp = model_A(R, lam=0.7, Rc=1.0)",
    "print(\"Model A viability:\", check_viability(fp, fpp, f, R))",
    "",
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(11, 3))",
    "axes[0].plot(R, f, lw=2); axes[0].plot(R, R, '--', color='gray', label='GR (f = R)')",
    "axes[0].set_xlabel('R/Rc'); axes[0].set_ylabel('f(R)'); axes[0].legend(fontsize=8); axes[0].set_title('(a)')",
    "axes[1].plot(R, fp, color='crimson', lw=2); axes[1].axhline(0, color='gray', lw=0.7)",
    "axes[1].set_xlabel('R/Rc'); axes[1].set_ylabel(\"f'(R)\"); axes[1].set_title(\"(b) no-ghost: f'>0\")",
    "axes[2].plot(R, fpp, color='green', lw=2)",
    "axes[2].set_xlabel('R/Rc'); axes[2].set_ylabel(\"f''(R)\"); axes[2].set_title(\"(c) no-tachyon: f''>0\")",
    "fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Figure 2 \u2014 Model B: $f_B(R) = R - \\\\lambda R_c \\\\tanh(R^2/R_c^2)$",
    "Fixes GR recovery at R=0 but reintroduces N2 violation (shaded region)."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "Model B viability: {'N1_no_ghost': True, 'N2_no_tachyon': False}",
      ""
     ]
    },
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {}
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "f, fp, fpp = model_B(R, lam=0.7, Rc=1.0)",
    "print(\"Model B viability:\", check_viability(fp, fpp, f, R))",
    "",
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(11, 3))",
    "axes[0].plot(R, f, lw=2); axes[0].plot(R, R, '--', color='gray', label='GR (f = R)')",
    "axes[0].set_xlabel('R/Rc'); axes[0].set_ylabel('f(R)'); axes[0].legend(fontsize=8); axes[0].set_title('(a)')",
    "axes[1].plot(R, fp, color='crimson', lw=2)",
    "axes[1].set_xlabel('R/Rc'); axes[1].set_ylabel(\"f'(R)\"); axes[1].set_title(\"(b) f'(R) -> 1 at R=0\")",
    "axes[2].plot(R, fpp, color='green', lw=2); axes[2].axhline(0, color='gray', lw=0.7)",
    "neg = fpp < 0",
    "if neg.any():",
    "    axes[2].axvspan(R[neg][0], R[neg][-1], color='pink', alpha=0.4)",
    "axes[2].set_xlabel('R/Rc'); axes[2].set_ylabel(\"f''(R)\"); axes[2].set_title(\"(c) f''<0 near R=0\")",
    "fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Section 4 \u2014 Solar-system chameleon thin-shell bound",
    "Model A calibrated for a visible cosmological signal violates the Cassini/thin-shell bound by 4-5 orders of magnitude."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "f_R0 = -0.0647",
      "|f_R0| / 1e-6 (solar-system bound) = 6.47e+04   <-- violates by ~4-5 orders of magnitude",
      ""
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fR0, R0 = fR0_model_A(lam=0.7, Rc=5.0, Om0=Om0, OL0=OL0)",
    "ratio = thin_shell_violation(fR0)",
    "print(f\"f_R0 = {fR0:.4f}\")",
    "print(f\"|f_R0| / 1e-6 (solar-system bound) = {ratio:.2e}   <-- violates by ~4-5 orders of magnitude\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Section 5 \u2014 Exact background ODE: forward-shooting instability",
    "Integrating Eq. (5.2) forward from matter domination blows up catastrophically -- this is why the field uses reverse-shooting or designer methods instead."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": [
      "Integration success: True",
      ""
     ]
    },
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {}
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "N, dev, ok = forward_shoot(c1=0.1, c2=0.5, Om0=Om0, OL0=OL0)",
    "print(\"Integration success:\", ok)",
    "",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,4))",
    "ax.semilogy(N, dev + 1e-16)",
    "ax.set_xlabel('N = ln(a)'); ax.set_ylabel('|dy/y_LCDM|  (log scale)')",
    "ax.set_title('Forward-shooting instability, Eq. (5.2)')",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Figure 3 \u2014 Scale-dependent effective Newton constant $G_{eff}(k,a)$"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {}
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "c1, c2 = 0.2, 1.0",
    "k = np.logspace(-3, np.log10(3), 200)",
    "R = designer_R(1.0, Om0, OL0)",
    "f, fp, fpp = hu_sawicki_n1(R, c1, c2, Om0)",
    "M2 = fp / (3*fpp)",
    "kappa2 = (k/1.0)**2",
    "Geff = (1.0/fp) * (1 + (1/3)*kappa2/(kappa2+M2))",
    "",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,4.2))",
    "ax.plot(k, Geff, color='darkgreen', lw=2)",
    "ax.axhline(1.0/fp, ls='--', color='gray', label='super-Compton limit')",
    "ax.axhline((4/3)/fp, ls=':', color='gray', label='sub-Compton limit (4/3)/f\\'')",
    "ax.axvspan(0.01, 0.2, color='orange', alpha=0.2, label='typical RSD survey range')",
    "ax.set_xscale('log'); ax.set_xlabel('k [h/Mpc]'); ax.set_ylabel('Geff(k,a=1)/G')",
    "ax.legend(fontsize=8); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Figure 4 \u2014 Scale dependence of the growth-rate observable $f\\\\sigma_8(z{=}0,k)$"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {}
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "k_vals = np.logspace(-3, np.log10(3), 8)",
    "vals = []",
    "for k in k_vals:",
    "    def model_func(R, c1=c1, c2=c2):",
    "        return hu_sawicki_n1(R, c1, c2, Om0)",
    "    v = fsigma8_of_z(Om0, OL0, model_func, 0.811, [0.0], k=k, model_func=model_func)",
    "    vals.append(v[0])",
    "",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,4.2))",
    "ax.plot(k_vals, vals, 'o-', color='purple')",
    "ax.set_xscale('log'); ax.set_xlabel('k [h/Mpc]'); ax.set_ylabel('fsigma8(z=0,k)')",
    "fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [

  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Figure 5 \u2014 Original five-point Model A fit"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure>"

     "metadata": {}

   ],
   "source": [
    "z5 = data['z_eff'].values[:5]; d5 = data['fsigma8'].values[:5]; e5 = data['sigma_eff'].values[:5]",
    "z_line = np.linspace(0, 0.3, 100)",
    "",
    "def fprime_GR(R):",
    "    return R, np.ones_like(R), np.zeros_like(R)",
    "fid = fsigma8_of_z(Om0, OL0, fprime_GR, 0.811, z_line)",
    "",
    "def fp_A(R):",
    "    return model_A(R, lam=-0.39, Rc=50.0)",
    "best = fsigma8_of_z(Om0, OL0, fp_A, 0.811, z_line)",
    "",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7,5))",
    "ax.errorbar(z5, d5, yerr=e5, fmt='o', capsize=3, label='compiled data')",
    "ax.plot(z_line, fid, '--', color='gray', label='Planck-LCDM (sigma8=0.811)')",
    "ax.plot(z_line, best, color='crimson', label='best-fit Model A')",
    "ax.set_xlabel('redshift z'); ax.set_ylabel('fsigma8(z)'); ax.legend(fontsize=8)",
    "fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()"
   ]
  },

   "source": [

   "cell_type": "code",

   "source": [
    "c1_best = float(table3.loc[table3.model=='Hu-Sawicki n=1','params'].values[0].split('c1=')[1].split(',')[0])",
    "c2_best = float(table3.loc[table3.model=='Hu-Sawicki n=1','params'].values[0].split('c2=')[1])",
    "s8_amp = float(table3.loc[table3.model=='LCDM + amplitude','params'].values[0].split('=')[1])",
    "",
    "z8 = data['z_eff'].values; d8 = data['fsigma8'].values; e8 = data['sigma_eff'].values",
    "z_line = np.linspace(0.0, 1.6, 100)",
    "fid = fsigma8_of_z(Om0, OL0, fprime_GR, 0.811, z_line)",
    "amp = fsigma8_of_z(Om0, OL0, fprime_GR, s8_amp, z_line)",
    "",
    "def model_func(R):",
    "    return hu_sawicki_n1(R, c1_best, c2_best, Om0)",
    "hs = fsigma8_of_z(Om0, OL0, model_func, 0.811, z_line, model_func=model_func)",
    "",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7,5))",
    "ax.errorbar(z8, d8, yerr=e8, fmt='ko', capsize=3, label=f'compiled data (N={len(z8)})')",
    "ax.plot(z_line, fid, '--', color='gray', label='fiducial LCDM (sigma8=0.811)')",
    "ax.plot(z_line, amp, color='crimson', label=f'LCDM + free amplitude (sigma8={s8_amp:.3f})')",
    "ax.plot(z_line, hs, ':', color='navy', lw=2, label='best-fit Hu-Sawicki (n=1) ~ GR')",
    "ax.set_xlabel('redshift z'); ax.set_ylabel('fsigma8(z)'); ax.legend(fontsize=8)",
    "fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()"
   ]
  },
